label: Texas Wastewater Treatment Plant Operator, Class C (TCEQ), need-to-know practice bank (Narrow)
purpose: Practice questions aligned to the TCEQ need-to-know categories for the Class C wastewater treatment plant operator. Scope is Narrow: the 20 TCEQ wastewater treatment categories only, with Class C depth (more calculations, process-control reasoning and troubleshooting per category). Practice questions aligned to the TCEQ need-to-know categories; not the official exam blueprint. TCEQ publishes no exam weights and no question counts. This bank claims no weights and no counts, and its per-category numbers are authoring choices, not exam proportions. It contains no state rule citations, no permit limits, no set points and no numerical design criteria.
reviewIntro: 402 original practice questions: 284 conceptual and 118 calculations, in US customary units. Scope is Narrow. The questions are aligned to the 20 TCEQ wastewater treatment need-to-know categories for the Class C level. They are practice questions aligned to the TCEQ need-to-know categories; not the official exam blueprint. No weights or counts are claimed. Calculations state every assumption; hypothetical values in stems are not TCEQ limits. Class A and B, collection classes, and water classes are excluded.
